title.en: How to use your operating brain

line.es: Una frase por cada cosa que hace. Díselas tal cual en el chat, desde el computador o el celular.
line.en: One phrase for each thing it does. Say them as written in the chat, on your computer or your phone.

appears.es: Te pregunta el idioma, prepara la carpeta en Drive y te entrevista sobre tu empresa.
appears.en: It asks the language, prepares the Drive folder and interviews you about your company.

picture.shows: a chat bubble with the phrase, a question about the language, and an arrow into a Drive folder holding three files

appears.es: Los valores que aplican, lo negociable y lo que no, el caso más parecido y la fuente de cada cosa.
appears.en: The values that apply, what bends and what does not, the closest past case, and the source of each.

picture.shows: a question bubble answered by a bubble built from three stacked pieces (values, closest case, source), each tied to a file card

appears.es: Cada día la rutina lee las reuniones grabadas y deja las decisiones, los playbooks al día y un resumen.
appears.en: Every day the routine reads the recorded meetings and leaves the decisions, updated playbooks and a summary.

picture.shows: a clock that fires once a day, pulling a recorded meeting and dropping three files into the folder: decision log, playbooks, summary

phrase.en: what did we decide about proposals?

appears.es: La decisión con su fecha, la reunión de donde salió y el playbook que cambió.
appears.en: The decision with its date, the meeting it came from and the playbook it changed.

picture.shows: a question bubble answered by one decision log line that points back to its meeting and forward to the playbook it changed

appears.es: Un borrador con el tono de tu empresa, marcado para revisar antes de enviar. Lo envías tú.
appears.en: A draft in your company's tone, marked for review before sending. You send it.

picture.shows: two panels: a flat draft on the left, the same draft rewritten on the right with a review stamp on top

phrase.es: procesa el transcript que dejé en entrada
phrase.en: process the transcript I left in the inbox

appears.es: El archivo de la reunión, sus decisiones en la bitácora y los playbooks que cambiaron.
appears.en: The meeting file, its decisions in the log and the playbooks that changed.

picture.shows: a text file with the date first dropped into the inbox folder, then fanning out into the log and a playbook

phrase.en: that decision is wrong, fix it

appears.es: Una línea nueva que corrige la anterior y el playbook con el texto correcto. Nada se borra.
appears.en: A new line that corrects the old one, and the playbook back to the right text. Nothing is deleted.

picture.shows: two panels of the same playbook section: the wrong text on the left moves down into History, the right text sits on top on the right

phrase.es: procesa el documento que dejé en documentos
phrase.en: process the document I left in documents

appears.es: El playbook de ese proceso, escrito desde el documento y con su fecha. El original no se toca.
appears.en: That process's playbook, written from the document and with its date. The original stays untouched.

picture.shows: an old manual in the documents folder stays in place while a new playbook card is drawn out of it

appears.es: Un caso con qué pasó, qué se hizo, cómo terminó, qué se aprendió y qué valor se aplicó.
appears.en: A case with what happened, what was done, how it ended, the lesson and the value applied.

picture.shows: a spoken story in a bubble becoming one case file with five parts, the last two highlighted

appears.es: Un informe con lo que ordenó y lo que queda pendiente. También corre sola cada semana.
appears.en: A report of what it tidied and what is still pending. It also runs on its own every week.

picture.shows: a weekly clock sweeping loose files back into their folders and leaving one report with a short pending list

phrase.es: a partir de hoy Ana es editora
phrase.en: from today Ana is an editor

appears.es: La tabla de roles actualizada con la fecha. Después ajustas tú los permisos de la carpeta en Drive.
appears.en: The roles table updated with the date. Then you adjust the folder's Drive permissions yourself.

picture.shows: a chat bubble moving a name into the editor row of a three-row roles table, with a separate Drive permissions box a person adjusts

phrase.es: puebla el cerebro con la empresa de ejemplo

appears.es: Una carpeta aparte con una empresa inventada: playbooks, bitácora, un caso y una reunión por procesar.
appears.en: A separate folder with a made-up company: playbooks, a log, a case and one meeting to process.

picture.shows: two folders side by side, the demo one filled with sample files and kept apart from the real one

limits.es: No manda correos, mensajes ni respuestas a clientes. Te deja borradores.
limits.en: It sends no email, message or client reply. It leaves you drafts.

limits.es: No borra nada: lo que cambia pasa al historial con su fecha.
limits.en: It deletes nothing: what changes moves to history with its date.

limits.es: No inventa políticas: si algo no está escrito, te lo dice.
limits.en: It invents no policy: if something is not written, it says so.

limits.es: Solo anota decisiones dichas con firmeza; lo demás queda por confirmar.
limits.en: It records only firm decisions; the rest stays pending confirmation.

limits.es: No cambia los valores sin el visto bueno del responsable del cerebro.
limits.en: It changes no values without the brain owner's approval.

limits.es: No graba reuniones: las lee de Fathom o del texto que pegas.
limits.en: It records no meetings: it reads them from Fathom or pasted text.

picture.shows: a closed door at the folder's edge with an envelope stopped in front of it; inside, a crossed-out eraser and a blank page marked not written
